title: How do I post a Club Membership early-termination fee charge?
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Club Membership early-termination fee charge: when it applies and how to post it.

## Applicable situation
An early-termination fee charge applies once the member has given notice of cancellation, where the tier's own minimum committed term has not yet elapsed. The amount actually billed is determined by this policy's own governing basis for the early-termination fee charge.

## Prerequisite: the member must not be in past-due standing
This policy's own basis holds that the member must currently be in active or frozen standing rather than past-due standing, since a cancellation request may only be filed from active or frozen status; where the membership contract is currently in past-due standing, this charge is not handled until that standing changes.

## How it is invoked
This is an internal tool that must first be unlocked and then called: charge_early_termination_fee_74e8dbe7.

## Parameters
- membership_id: names the contract to bill; retrieved from a prior lookup of the member's own membership holdings.
- customer_id: names the member behind that contract; likewise available from the member's profile or membership holdings.
- amount_usd: the early-termination figure, in US dollars to exactly 2 decimal places; always required, and never negative.

## Return
On success, the call reports the new entry's own reference number, together with the contract and dollar figure billed. Where the contract cannot be found on file, the return text itself states that instead of an error being raised.

## Points of judgement
A repeat call to charge_early_termination_fee_74e8dbe7 for what was really one cancellation notice does not amend the first entry; it adds a wholly separate early-termination-fee entry alongside it.
